title: First Light Under Dead Stone
description: Aten Ra advances through sacred temple approach with shallow river-light lanes and low sandstone cover while the Gate tests whether solar law can hold under pressure. Appearance rule: Solar Dominion of Khepra is the source culture humans later copied as Egyptian solar myth; mission terrain and cosmetics must show Aten hand-rays, Ma’at scale geometry, electrum, royal linen-light, faience turquoise, lapis, obsidian, Nile-black silt glass, Red Land jasper.
lore: This mission treats Solar Dominion of Khepra as the origin behind Egyptian solar myth: battlefield architecture, reward cosmetics, relic props, and hazard silhouettes must use Aten hand-rays, Ma’at scale geometry, electrum, royal linen-light, faience turquoise, lapis, obsidian, Nile-black silt glass, Red Land jasper instead of generic historical or RPG dressing.
terrain: sacred temple approach with shallow river-light lanes and low sandstone cover; source-culture appearance layer: sun-scale courts, pylon shadow lanes, river-light channels, Khepri dawn engines, Ma’at seal platforms, desert storm edges; cosmetic/relic silhouettes: Ma’at was-sceptre blades, electrum wesekh source-plates, Khepri scarab cores, Uraeus counter-edict silhouettes

objectives.primary: Drive your active Titan to the marked solar seal before the Hollow closes around it.
optional: Complete before turn 8
Keep your active Titan above 40% integrity
Trigger at least two Momentum, Divinity, or terrain reactions

enemyWaves.entry: deployed at opposing gate markers
reinforcement from shadowed lane

specialRules: Solar Law: Momentum grows when the lone Titan holds marked light lanes without retreating.
Hollow Drift: enemies punish exposed Titan positioning and reckless routes.
Solo Titanic Scale: one player-controlled Titan occupies the tactical focus; enemies, elites, and bosses scale around that single presence.
victoryConditions: Drive your active Titan to the marked solar seal before the Hollow closes around it.

lore: This mission treats Infernal Dominion as the origin behind hell, demonology, and infernal contract myth: battlefield architecture, reward cosmetics, relic props, and hazard silhouettes must use black iron crowns, volcanic glass, contract parchment, chain mantles, blood wax seals, horn hierarchies, ash velvet, hellfire clauses instead of generic historical or RPG dressing.
terrain: cinder crown gate under obsidian arches and royal flame; source-culture appearance layer: black iron courts, volcanic glass aisles, ember chain channels, debtor seal floors, contract dais, obsidian throne shadows; cosmetic/relic silhouettes: Goetic chain-crown blades, volcanic glass debtor plates, blood-wax infernal ledger cores, chain-lien reversals

objectives.primary: Complete Elite: Crown of Cinders: Hidden Law with one active Titan while reading cinder crown gate under obsidian arches and royal flame and preserving faction doctrine.
optional: Win with no Titan defeated
Resolve at least three Infernal Dominion doctrine actions
Hold every objective for one full enemy turn
Trigger at least one Momentum or Divinity decision before victory

enemyWaves.entry: emerge through infernal contracts pressure fractures
cross-faction Aten Ra reinforcement

specialRules: Dominion Claim: executions refund Momentum when the Titan controls chain-marked ground.
Bargain Mark: accepting risk creates stronger rewards but harsher enemy turns.
Dominion Flame: decisive aggression turns enemy weakness into momentum.
Elite Hazard: secondary realm pressure starts active.
Elite Command: enemy support persists until objective action breaks the source.
Solo Titanic Scale: one active Titan occupies the tactical focus; enemies, elites, and bosses scale around that single presence.
Cross-Faction Threat: Aten Ra enemies join the Hollow in this elite encounter.
victoryConditions: Complete Elite: Crown of Cinders: Hidden Law with one active Titan while reading cinder crown gate under obsidian arches and royal flame and preserving faction doctrine.
